description: extract_match_type, extract_comparator, and extract_address_part each allocate a Vec<&Form> (remaining) as output. These are chained: extract_match_type returns remaining, which is passed to extract_comparator which returns remaining again, etc. Three Vec allocations per test evaluation. An iterator-chaining approach (filter_map, scan) could avoid the intermediary Vecs entirely -- collect only when the string-list arguments are finally needed.
title: sieve-native: extract_match_type and extract_comparator allocate Vec<&Form> on each test call
